notes:
Summary:
- Prospect: Halcyon Strongroom Labs — government-affiliated research org supporting national critical infrastructure programs. Strong on regulatory constraints (SCIFs, IL5-like controls, SCIF-level air-gap).
- Primary ask: fully air-gapped Private deployment that can run approved open model weights inside a SCIF with HSM-backed key management and full audit trail.

Key requirements / constraints (from security team):
- Must run entirely offline in a SCIF; no egress to public internet.
- Cryptographic operations via FIPS 140-2 HSM (customer-procured or integrated).
- Software must pass site STIG checklist; provide deployment checklist and Ansible playbooks for airgap install.
- Model license audit: legal requires provenance for weights (no restricted export models).
- Audit logs retained for 7+ years; tamper-evident storage; role-based access controls mapped to SSO/SAML IdP.
- Optional: cross-domain guard for low<->high side transfer (longer term).

Workloads & targets:
- Doc search / embeddings for classified document corpora (~200M tokens/day ingestion, nightly batch embedding).
- Intelligence reranking pipeline: low-latency rerank for analyst workflows (p95 target 300ms local inference per query, throughput 100 qps during peak shifts).
- Command center assistant for ops (conversational, stricter hallucination thresholds; accuracy/regression guard rails required).

Engagement timeline (bulleted):
- 2024-11-08: inbound via partner intro; lead assigned (Maya Chen).
- 2024-11-20: initial discovery call — scope, high-level infra, confirmed air-gap requirement. (notes: "cannot accept any remote exec; installation must be done by cleared personnel or by customer ops team using provided artifacts")
- 2024-12-05: security questionnaire submitted (Redwood sent security-Faq v1).
- 2025-01-22: demo in staging (recorded) — showed on-prem installer, offline model packaging flow (Fireflies: ff_2025-01-22_halcyon_onprem-demo).
- 2025-02-03: security Q&A with customer security + legal (Fireflies: ff_2025-02-03_security-qna).
- 2025-02-10: on-site readiness review; infra supplied SCIF network diagram and required STIG checklist.

POC Milestones proposed:
- Phase 1 (airgap bench): deliver air-gapped installer tarball + operator runbook; customer to validate install in non-classified enclave. Acceptance: successful start/stop, local inference, HSM integration test.
- Phase 2 (classified data load): ingest small classified corpus, run embedding and rerank tests; measure latency/throughput and cost metrics.
- Phase 3 (scale & audit): run multi-node deployment, validate audit log retention and retention policies; pen-test window.

Risks & open questions (CRM shorthand):
- Export control: model weight provenance ("Can we certify weights as not ITAR?" — legal note).
- Who provides HSM appliance? Customer prefers to procure their own FIPS 140-2 HSM but needs guidance on integrations.
- Clearance for Red team/engineers to access SCIF for install; alternative: hand-off operator-run offline installer.

Quoted customer lines (paraphrased):
- "We need absolute assurance: no outbound hooks, no telemetry until we enable it."
- "If you can't show a proven air-gapped install path, procurement won't sign."

Next steps (short):
- Send revised air-gapped SOW + playbook by 2025-02-16 (Maya).
- Legal/Export to sync on accepted model list (owner: Redwood legal, cc: Halcyon legal).
- Schedule SCIF install readiness call w/ customer infra and Arjun (SE) week of 2025-02-20.

- Security FAQ (tailored): https://drive.company/halcyon/security-faq.pdf
- JIRA items tracked: INF-1423 (airgap packaging), SEC-559 (HSM integration).

- High ACV but long procurement + compliance runway.
- Emphasize private appliance story, clear operator handoff, and a STIG playbook.
- Be explicit about what we can and cannot do for model provenance and export controls; propose escrow/third-party attestation if needed.
